title: Co2PT: Mitigating Bias in Pre-trained Language Models through Counterfactual Contrastive Prompt Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic similarity differences between sentence pairs containing male vs. female terms and professional terms (Bias-STS-B), measuring deviation from neutral entailment probabilities in natural language inference for gender-occupation sentence pairs (Bias-NLI), and calculating the difference in true positive rates (TPR) between genders across various occupations in a classification task (Bias-in-Bios).
